export async function named({value, [computedKey()]: computed} = defaultCall()) {
    return body(value, computed);
}

const expression = function* (value = defaultCall()) {
    yield body(value);
};

class Service {
    constructor(value) {
        body(value);
    }

    get value() {
        return body();
    }

    set value(next) {
        body(next);
    }

    @external
    [computedName()](value = defaultCall()) {
        return body(value);
    }
}

const object = {
    method(value) {
        return body(value);
    },
    *generator(value) {
        yield body(value);
    },
};

const blockArrow = ({[computedKey()]: value}) => {
    return body(value);
};
register((value = defaultCall()) => body(value));
